# iFixx Remodeling & Handyman Services

> South Charlotte's handyman and repair crew, and the team that remodels the kitchen once you trust us with the drywall.

## About

iFIXX Remodeling LLC is a family-owned home services contractor based in South Charlotte, NC, working since 2019. We fix what's broken first: drywall, painting, decks, fences, doors and windows, and the small jobs nobody else will drive out for. We also handle kitchen and bathroom remodels, new decks, and screened porches.

We are fully insured. The owner answers the phone. Minimum for a repair visit is $150, and you get the price before the work starts.

- Phone: (980) 391-6833
- Email: ifixx.hs@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.ifixxnc.com
- Home base: South Charlotte, NC

## Services

### Home Repairs — https://www.ifixxnc.com/repairs
- Drywall and ceiling repair, including texture matching
- Interior and exterior painting
- Deck repair: soft boards, wood rot, railings, steps
- Fence repair: leaning posts, sagging gates, storm damage
- Carpentry and trim
- Doors and windows
- Furniture assembly
- TV mounting
- Quick fixes and small repairs

### Remodeling — https://www.ifixxnc.com/remodeling
Interior:
- Kitchen remodeling
- Bathroom remodeling
- Flooring installation

Exterior:
- Deck building and rebuilds
- Screened porches

## How Estimates Work

- Small repairs: text or email photos and a short description to (980) 391-6833 and a person calls you back with the estimate the same business day.
- Remodeling (kitchens, bathrooms, new decks, porches): in-person estimate, with a render included on projects over $5,000.

Note: iFIXX does not offer plumbing, electrical, or HVAC services. Plumbing, electrical, and HVAC work is referred out to the specialist trade. iFIXX does not offer emergency, 24/7, or same-day repair service.
